entries.speaker: Ohya
entries.en: I just got my bonus,[n]so I'm going to get some of[n]the more expensive sushi today.

entries.speaker: Ohya
entries.en: C'mon, don't hold back![n]Order anything you want.

entries.speaker: Ohya
entries.en: Think of it as a thanks for[n]all the info you've given me.

entries.speaker: Ohya
entries.en: Plus, I like to eat normal food[n]once in a while too, you know.
Let's keep our spirits up.[clr 27]
Easy on the alcohol, okay?
Normal food...?

entries.speaker: Ohya
entries.en: Heh... Yeah, you're right.

entries.speaker: Ohya
entries.en: Let's make sure we get nice[n]and energized for our[n]next big mission.

entries.speaker: Ohya
entries.en: Sure.

entries.speaker: Ohya
entries.en: ...You didn't seriously think I[n]would agree to that, right?[n]A lady's gotta have her drinks!

entries.speaker: Ohya
entries.en: Hahaha! Don't worry about it.

entries.speaker: Ohya
entries.en: When you get an opportunity like[n]this, you gotta eat as much as[n]you can.

entries.speaker: Ohya
entries.en: Okay, it's on me today![n]Knock yourself out!

entries.speaker: Ohya
entries.en: Wow, you ate a ton... [n]Well, I guess that's normal[n]for a high school kid.

entries.speaker: Ohya
entries.en: ...I'll just have you make up [n]for it with more scoops.[n]I'll be counting on you!

entries.speaker: Ohya
entries.en: Well, I guess we should get [n]going. Let's get some sushi to go[n]and stop by Lala-chan's place.

entries.speaker: Ohya
entries.en: Hey... I didn't know you [n]could buy this.

entries.speaker: Ohya
entries.en: All right, I'm giving you one [n]as a gift! Now we'll each have[n]one piece of a matching set.

entries.speaker: Ohya
entries.en: Thanks for today! I'll be [n]counting on you for more info.
